# DPF Camera release notes

## 0.16.5

- Signed stable application updates with explicit operator confirmation.
- Clear installed/available version, update status and check timestamps.
- Equivalent signature validation for online and signed offline updates.
- Verified backup before activation and strict service/identity checks afterward.
- Automatic restoration of the previous release when validation fails.
- Application-only updater bootstrap; no operating-system or unattended updates.

Production approval and fleet acceptance are published separately; these notes alone do not establish approval.
